basic_info.description: This stunning remodeled Noe Valley condominium offers sophisticated design and beautiful contemporary finishes. Thoughtfully updated, this property features 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, soaring high ceilings, a spacious and ideal open floor plan with refinished hardwood floors throughout, a gorgeous living room with stone-wrapped fireplace and custom floating shelves, excellent natural light, and a sleek modern kitchen with dark countertops, stainless steel appliances, and wine fridge. Additional amenities include in-unit laundry, a modern bathroom with LED lighting mirror and designer vanity featuring quartz counter and walnut veneer paneling, plus a charming common backyard with seating areas and convenient storage. Located in a charming classic Victorian building, this spectacular property sits on a prime block adjacent to Juri Commons Park and the vibrant Noe Valley 24th Street and Valencia corridor, showcasing exquisite restaurants, trendy boutiques, and vibrant cafes. Noe Valley is one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, offering great weather and the urban lifestyle sought by many people living in San Francisco, with several convenient transportation options including BART, MUNI surface trains, corporate shuttle buses, and excellent freeway access to Silicon Valley.
